nonBlockingFindings.finding: The pre-existing equipment portrait has a small lower-edge atlas fragment. It is not a new talent drawing or a claim to corrected sprite cropping; the new menu and budget controls are unaffected.
Several temporary success notifications are visible while the collector buys consecutive ranks. Permanent card text remains available after the notifications fade.

scope: Executed public DEV talent menus, five functional save/purchase groups and nine actually opened viewports. No production result, original-tree likeness or physical hardware test is claimed.
limitations: Prepared native fixtures give XP directly for a bounded menu/save inspection; that XP is not claimed earned in this browser.
One Normandy soldier, one Normandy engineer and one early Eden engineer context are inspected. Complete original talent trees and physical controller/hardware performance are not certified.
All talent ranks, durations and multipliers remain ATB adaptations. Native combat effects have separate integration tests.
